caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped container, primarily colored in light brown and ochre tones, with a painted scene on its side. The main image on the side features a building labeled "DEAF AND DUMB ASYLUM," depicted in shades of brown, white, and purple, surrounded by green and yellow trees and set against a grounds with pathways, stairs, and greenery. There are additional smaller buildings and vegetation, shown in similar muted colors, framing the central building. The lid of the container is decorated with a landscape scene in subdued hues of green and brown, and is bordered with a blue band decorated with a repeating pattern of round shapes in blue, yellow, and pink. A small, loop-shaped handle is attached near the top edge of the container. The background of the drawing is unadorned and beige.
title: Bandbox
